cohort: Nulliparous Somali-born women who gave birth in Norway between 1990 and 2014
finding: Contrary to expectations, women with Type 3 FGM/C had a lower risk of cesarean section compared to women without FGM/C, and deinfibulation before labor did not reduce cesarean section risk.
mod_finding: Deinfibulation before labor did not protect against cesarean section.
